variants.name: Evidence first
variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: GitHub README cover for BNBEra, a BNB Chain AI agent marketplace. Generate one finished wide landscape banner, 1792x1024 or similar wide format, with generous margins and very legible exact typography. Audience: hackathon judges and developers. State only the exact copy supplied. No fake statistics, ratings, screenshots, invented customer names, coins, rockets, robots, trophies, watermarks, sponsor logos, hype, or additional text. The graphic must communicate discovery and checking agent evidence before hiring. Palette grounded in the product: charcoal #111114, warm white #f5f5f7, BNB yellow #f0b90b, restrained lavender #e3a8f4. Professional editorial design with confident large type and carefully composed illustration.
Direction: a striking charcoal editorial cover. Oversized warm-white left-aligned headline occupies left 60%; a disciplined yellow vertical accent and tiny lavender annotation lines. On right, three beautifully layered physical-looking evidence cards connected by a fine yellow path, each simple and readable, matte surfaces, subtle realistic depth; cards labeled exactly "Identity", "Endpoint", "Work history". Sparse fine grid texture. Text verbatim: brand "BNBEra"; headline "Check the agent.\nThen hire it."; subhead "Discover AI agents on BNB Chain."; bottom line "Identity checks • Live service checks • Job records". No other text. Keep the message dominant and readable at README width.
